steps.content: Chief, Chief! Can you hear me? Is everything okay?
You wake up to a voice from the comms and find yourself and EMP locked in a pitch-dark room. That's Nightingale's voice from the communication device you carry.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm fine. EMP is conscious too and looks okay. How's the situation now?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: That's good. From what we understand, the ducks at the Supply Office have acquired mecha armor and weapons through unknown means, and they've launched an attack on the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I've closed all internal passageways in the Bureau and activated the internal alert. But while trying to isolate the ducks in the underground storage area, it seems I've also trapped you there.

You look around and find that aside from a locked door, there's indeed no other way out. With the room being filled with cardboard boxes, EMP's ability could cause a fire and is thus unusable. You must find a way to open the door from the outside.
You hear the movement of mecha armor outside the door and realize that the storage outside is full of patrolling mecha ducks.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Did you just say they launched the attack after acquiring the mecha armor?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So... if we can make them lose their mecha armor unknowingly, we'd have a chance to strike back?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Got it. I'll arrange for competent Sinners to infiltrate the underground storage. Please help them pinpoint the energy reaction coordinates of the ducks' mecha armor!
Hehe, silly Chief! I knew you couldn't do anything without me! And look how pathetic this Syndicate's disgrace has become now!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Damn it, have I really fallen so low that I must rely on Minos's trash to save me?! Chief, can't you ask for someone else?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey! I'm literally risking my life to come and check on you guys. You better appreciate it! Don't forget to thank me when you get out!
